Summary

Pixel Adventures Vol. 1 is a FREE music pack made specifically for 2D pixel art RPG, Adventure, Fantasy, and other retro games! All music is made using the YMCK Magical 8 Bit Plug , which authentically emulates 8 bit sounds from the NES era of games. Inspirations for the music include Pokemon, Undertale, Stardew Valley,  Legend of Zelda, and Final Fantasy. 


This pack is completely free to use for any commercial and non-commercial use. Credit is appreciated but not necessary :) 


This pack contains 10 full original tracks that are seamlessly loopable to be used in your games, as well as a jingle to play when the player either wins or loses. Provided is  a name for the environment the track was written for and an individual name; although I wrote these with the environment name in mind, please feel free to use them in whatever context you'd like. 


Track List

1. Title Theme - Adventure's Spirit 

2. Overworld 1 - A Great Journey 

3. Battle - Gearing Up

4. Cave - A Hollow Darkness

5. Ambient - Loading...

6. Town - Red Leaf Town

7. Shop - The Merchant 

8. Overworld 2 - Magic Elderwood Forest 

9. Dungeon - Secret Passage 

10. Boss Battle - The Beast's Lair 


All tracks are exported  as .wav files at 48kHz and 24 bit


Contact

All music is composed by domi.wav (Dominic Sandefur). For any questions about the pack or commissions, please email me at domi.wav.music@gmail.com


If you use this pack in a game, feel free to send it my way if you feel comfortable, I would absolutely love to see how you use it! Finally, if you like this pack, please consider leaving a review or even  just a comment, I would love to hear from you all thanks :)
